heading: DSC container load errors (-500 .. -549)
text:
### DSC container load errors (-500 .. -549) [IERR.2.8a]

The DSC container's codes, and two reserved blocks. AOT code has its own band
below ([IERR.2.8b]); the two bands together are the artefact-load category,
-500 .. -599 ([NERR.3.1]).

**DSC container (-500 .. -504, -506, -507, -514).** Returned by the DSC
loader; the detail names the failing atom, the byte
offset and the violated RDSC rule ([NERR.8.1],
[RDSC.11.1]). -514, `DS_ERR_DSC_CAPABILITY_ABSENT`, names
the capability the build lacks rather than an atom
([RDSC.16.2.7]).

**Reserved, never reused: -505.**
Every multiplicity is the compiler's guarantee and a runtime
checks for no second atom ([RDSC.7.2]),
so nothing returns it. A `node_id` that is 0 or held
twice is `DS_ERR_RETP_INVALID` ([RDSC.11.1]).

**Reserved, never reused: -508 .. -513 and -520 .. -527.**
Nothing returns them. The header declares no name for them, and no value
is reissued ([STYL.2.8.7]).

A malformed builtin call is still reported. Arity is a
**compile-time** guarantee the runtime does not re-check, and
a call naming an op with no registered handler is
`DS_ERR_FN_NOT_FOUND` ([RDSC.4a.9.3]).
